review_plan.claim_under_review: Whether the completed fixed12-card run is an admissible receipt and its finite predicate/classification metrics match independently checked statements. No hypothesis-status or asymptotic promotion is requested.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: The elementary fixtures should yield four certified, four contradicted and four underdeclared outcomes. A label-only implementation, missed domain clause or invalid completion witness is the likeliest defect; this is a preregistered expectation, not evidence.

joints.attack_plan: Independently derive each scalar/invariance/permutation statement and both completions for every underdeclared card; compare to frozen oracle and raw certificates. Specifically test zero scalar, affine origin shift and whole-space versus subgroup domain.
joints.breaking_artifact: Exact card/completion and point witness or invalid oracle identified.

joints.attack_plan: Check manifest/source hashes/command/seed/environment and coverage; recompute all metrics from raw results with a separately authored checker and reconcile resources and controls.
joints.breaking_artifact: A missing or hash-mismatched artifact, unaccounted run, metric disagreement or unsupported stronger claim.

blindness.rationale: One fresh validator session, separate from the producer. This is ordinary source-aware validation; no blinded rederivation is claimed.

proves_too_much.failure_signature: Each must reject the nonzero-scalar restriction while retaining any weaker true property; U1-U4 must remain underdeclared.

blind_rederivation.quantity: Not requested as a formally blinded task. Validator performs independent source-aware derivation/checking.
blind_rederivation.parameters: Exactly the fixed twelve synthetic cards overF_2/F_5.
